$comment: GitHub Actions policy exemptions (#1286). Every third-party action must be pinned to a 40-character commit SHA; an entry here is the only way out, and it must name the exact reference, a release tag (vX.Y.Z), and why. An entry no workflow uses fails the check. See docs/runbooks/workflow-policy.md.

exemptions.reason: The SLSA generator verifies its own reference and only supports being called by a release tag; calling it by commit SHA fails provenance generation. It is a reusable workflow, not an action, and the tag is a signed SLSA release.
